label: recycledContent
comment: The fraction (by mass) of recycled / repurposed, repaired content in this product.  This will be the total virgin content fraction.

domainIncludes.comment: High level corcularity information about this product.  Note that this doens not substitute for detailed product circularity data sheet (PCDS) criteria which would be represented as a set of conformity claims against individual ISO PCDS criteria.
